import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.4009, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.4009, 0.1316) \
     .threePointArc((0.3768, 0.1115), (0.3614, 0.1388)) \
     .threePointArc((0.1903, 0.0182), (0.0152, 0.133)) \
     .threePointArc((0.0095, 0.1222), (0.0, 0.1299)) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Add the circles
r = r.moveTo(0.0079, 0.1299).circle(0.0079) \
     .moveTo(0.3805, 0.1316).circle(0.0204)

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0582)

# Translate the model
r = r.translate((0.3491, 0.1164, 0.0))

# Final model
r  # This will be the final model

import cadquery as cq

# Part 1: Rectangular Block with Curved Top
part_1 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0, 0)
    .lineTo(0.4009, 0)
    .lineTo(0.4009, 0.1164)
    .threePointArc((0.3871, 0.1478), (0.3557, 0.152))
    .threePointArc((0.1016, 0.0291), (0.0291, 0.1016))
    .threePointArc((0.0239, 0.1478), (0, 0.152))
    .close()
    .extrude(0.0582)
    .translate((0, 0, 0.0291))
)

# Part 2: Cylindrical Cutout
part_2 = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(0.0145, 0.0145)
    .circle(0.0145)
    .extrude(-0.0291)
    .rotate((0, 0, 0), (0, 0, 1), -90)
    .translate((0.0291, 0.152, 0.0291))
)

# Combine the parts
r = part_1.cut(part_2)

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
W = 0.4009   # X
D = 0.1520   # Y
T = 0.0582   # Z (thickness)

# Key profile parameters (top view, XY plane)
finger_w = 0.024          # width of the left finger
tip_cx = finger_w / 2.0   # center X of rounded tip
tip_cy = 0.138            # center Y of rounded tip
tip_r = finger_w / 2.0    # tip radius
fillet_r = 0.020          # top-right corner fillet radius

# Profile points
x0 = 0.0
x1 = W
fil_start = (W, D - fillet_r)              # bottom of top-right fillet
fil_end = (W - fillet_r, D)                # top of top-right fillet (tangent)
arc_start = (finger_w, tip_cy)             # right side of tip circle
arc_mid = (0.20, 0.050)                    # lowest point of concave arc
tip_top = (tip_cx, tip_cy + tip_r)         # top of tip circle

# Build the plate profile and extrude
part = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(x0, 0.0)
    .lineTo(x1, 0.0)                       # bottom edge
    .lineTo(fil_start[0], fil_start[1])    # right edge up to fillet
    .radiusArc(fil_end, fillet_r)          # top-right corner fillet
    .threePointArc(arc_mid, arc_start)     # big concave arc back to the tip
    .radiusArc((x0, tip_cy), -tip_r)       # rounded tip of the finger
    .lineTo(x0, 0.0)                       # left edge down
    .close()
    .extrude(T)
)

r = part

import cadquery as cq

# Create the sketch
sketch = cq.Sketch() \
    .segment((0.0, 0.0), (0.4009, 0.0)) \
    .segment((0.4009, 0.152)) \
    .arc((0.4009, 0.152), (0.4009, 0.0), -0.25) \
    .segment((0.0, 0.0), (0.0, 0.152)) \
    .arc((0.0, 0.152), (0.0, 0.0), -0.25) \
    .assemble()

# Extrude the sketch
r = cq.Workplane().placeSketch(sketch).extrude(0.0582)
